title: chore: migrate `create-instantsearch-app` to monorepo
body:
**Summary**

Didn't have to change any code in CISA itself, just some changes to how we run tests in the monorepo, some configs to adapt as well.

**Result**

* \[X] Tests, lint and type checking work and are ran from the root
* \[X] Updated all templates to reference `instantsearch.js` and proper new path of `create-instantsearch-app`
* \[x] Created `templates` branch and updated GitHub action
* \[X] Updated contributing guide with how to replace all #xxx in reference to original repo name
